newsitem.title: USA: HFS Inc Q1 net income jumps.
newsitem.headline: HFS Inc Q1 net income jumps.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Results assume the combined results of HFS for Q1 1997 and Q1 1996 with the related quarter calendar results of PHH Corp. A merger between the companies closed on April 30.
Earnings Before Interest Expense, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization rose 119 percent in Q1 1997 to $212.1 million from $96.75 million.

Q1 1997 EPS, which rose 79 percent, are presented on a fully diluted basis. 1996 Q1 data assumes the $150 million 4.5 percent convertible notes are converted into 8.3 million common shares. After-tax interest expense of $1.1 million for the quarter are added back to net income for the respective periods in computed fully diluted EPS.

Additionally, EPS including PHH for Q1 1997 assumes the $240 million 4.75 percent convertible notes are converted into 3.6 million common shares. After-tax interest expense of $1.8 million for the quarter are addeed back to net income for the respective period in computed fully diluted EPS.
